title.narrative: Scaling Cooperative Resilience: Data-Driven Horticulture in Burkina Faso

description.narrative: The project “Scaling Cooperative Resilience: Data-Driven Horticulture in Burkina Faso” aims to strengthen the horticulture sector in Northern Burkina Faso by professionalising farmers’ cooperatives and enhancing their role as inclusive, market-oriented service providers. It will target 50 village-level cooperatives and four umbrella organisations, representing approximately 5,000 smallholder farmers, with a strong focus on women and youth inclusion.The core objective is to improve the performance, governance, and financial sustainability of cooperatives through a combination of capacity building and digital innovation. Two key technologies will be introduced: a Digital Marketplace to improve market access and transparency in transactions, and a Credit Profiling Module to facilitate access to finance by generating data-driven creditworthiness profiles. These innovations will be embedded within the FarmerLink platform and supported by training in governance, financial management, and digital literacy.The project will contribute to long-term development impact by enabling cooperatives to operate as professional, data-driven businesses capable of delivering services such as aggregation, storage, input supply, and access to finance. This will strengthen their position within the value chain and improve linkages with buyers and financial institutions.At farmer level, the project will enhance productivity, income, and resilience through improved access to services, better market opportunities, and data-informed decision-making. The initiative is expected to create approximately 250 jobs and improve financial and market access for the majority of participating cooperatives.Ultimately, the project will contribute to a more inclusive, resilient, and competitive horticulture sector in Burkina Faso, supporting sustainable economic growth, improved livelihoods, and food security.
